name: manyak-tv-v2
description: MANYAK TV V2 - Professional Microservices Platform
author: MANYAK TV Team

scripts.build:api: cd packages/database && npx prisma generate && cd ../../apps/api && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:bot: cd packages/database && npx prisma generate && cd ../../apps/bot && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:encoder: cd packages/database && npx prisma generate && cd ../../apps/encoder && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:web: cd apps/web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.start:api: cd apps/api && npx prisma generate --schema=../../packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && cd ../.. && npx prisma db push --schema=./packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && cd apps/api && npm run start:prod
